overview: The Council approved a local business license, addressed resident concerns regarding fire department infrastructure, and discussed long-standing parking issues on Elm Street. The body also recognized the local Citizen of the Year for her work on the opioid crisis.

items.title: Common Victualler License - 49 High Street
items.summary: Approved a common victualler license for Mike Pinnock to operate Crystal, a restaurant serving Caribbean and Spanish cuisine.

items.title: Fire Department Facility Requirements
items.summary: Resident Jeanne Martin petitioned the council to highlight the hazardous nature of firefighting and the urgent need for a new fire headquarters, potentially combined with the proposed police station.

items.title: Elm Street Parking Resolution
items.summary: Passed a resolution to coordinate a meeting between the Traffic Commission, the Department of Conservation and Recreation (DCR), and city officials to resolve parking restrictions that prevent residents from parking partially on the sidewalk.

items.title: Commendation of Cheryl Delfano
items.summary: Congratulated Cheryl Delfano on her selection as Citizen of the Year, noting her dedicated service to families affected by the opioid epidemic.

items.title: Zoning Meetings and Police Bond Announcements
items.summary: Noted the cancellation of recent zoning subcommittee meetings and announced upcoming Committee of the Whole meetings regarding the police station bond proposal.

items.title: Tabling of Meeting Records
items.summary: Tabled the approval of meeting records until the following week due to a councilor's illness.
